question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
Here the correct answer is** Published.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given passage, the blank needs to be filled with a word that indicates the release or dissemination of the study in Nature Human Behaviour.
 
• Among the options provided, **"published"** is the most suitable choice.
 
• To publish a study means to make it publicly available, usually through a scientific journal or other platforms. It indicates that the study has been completed, reviewed, and made accessible to the public or the scientific community.
 
 
• Example sentence with the correct answer: "In a new study **published **in Nature Human Behaviour, we have now shown that, in 2021, life expectancy rebounded somewhat in most western European countries."
 
 
 
• **Option 2) registered** does not fit the context as it does not convey the act of releasing or making the study available to the public.
 
• **Option 3) surrounded** does not make sense in this context as it does not relate to the study or its dissemination.
 
• **Option 4) established **is not the most appropriate choice because it does not specifically refer to the publication of the study.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **1) published,** as it accurately reflects the action of releasing the study in Nature Human Behaviour.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Published (प्रकाशित)** - Prepared and issued for public sale or readership.

 
 
• Example: Her first book was published last year by a famous publishing house.
 
 
 
• **Registered (पंजीकृत / नोंदणीकृत) **- Entered or recorded on an official list or directory.
 
 
• Example: I have registered my name for the upcoming seminar on climate change.
 
 
 
• **Surrounded (घेरा)** - Be all around (someone or something).
 
 
• Example: The castle was surrounded by a high wall.
 
 
 
• **Established (स्थापित)** - Set up on a firm or permanent basis.
 
 
• Example: The university was established in the 19th century.
